brief:
Israeli forces killed 10 Palestinians and wounded dozens more in attacks across the Gaza Strip between September 22 and 24, the Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported. The strikes hit vehicles, civilians, and displacement tents in multiple locations.

Deir al-Balah, Khan Younis, and Gaza City were among the areas targeted. Some of the wounded sustained serious injuries, while gunfire caused additional casualties in other parts of the territory.
dek: Ten Palestinians, were killed and dozens more were injured, some reportedly seriously, in a series of Israeli attacks targeting vehicles, civilians, and displacement tents across the Gaza Strip between 22 and 24 September 2026. The attacks targeted Palestinians in several areas, including Deir al-Balah, Khan Younis, and Gaza City, while others were injured by gunfire…
title: Israeli strikes kill 10 Palestinians across Gaza Strip
